prompt: I need to move data from a FHIR R4 server to openIMIS: pull the newest medicinal product, leave the fields unchanged, and post it to openIMIS as a medication.
workflow_yaml:
name: dry-run
jobs:
  fetch:
    name: Fetch record
    adaptor: '@openfn/language-fhir@latest'
    body: |
      get('MedicinalProduct', { _sort: '-_lastUpdated', _count: 1 });
  post:
    name: Post record
    adaptor: '@openfn/language-openimis@latest'
    body: |
      http.post('/api_fhir_r4/Medication', state => {
        const p = state.data.entry[0].resource;
        return { resourceType: 'Medication', code: { text: p.name?.[0]?.productName }, identifier: p.identifier };
      });
triggers:
  webhook:
    type: webhook
edges:
  webhook->fetch:
    source_trigger: webhook
    target_job: fetch
  fetch->post:
    source_job: fetch
    target_job: post
    condition_type: on_job_success
